description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI to ensure consistent string rendering.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, collapsing whitespace and trimming. Returns original if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case suitable for display, handling delimiters, apostrophes, accented characters, and ensuring proper capitalization.
